integrity: The exact all-size theorem is proved symbolically; the bundled standalone script checks only a finite sample with exact arithmetic. This is an original mathematical synthesis subject to independent validation, not a claim of external certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple undirected unweighted bipartite graphs; classical completed fourth-order Runge–Kutta heat polynomial only; excludes directed, weighted, nonbipartite and internal-stage positivity. Relevant specialist literature may remain unindexed. Formal independent proof audit not yet performed.
title: A local all-step RK4 positivity law for every unweighted bipartite network
